title: ai-rulez organization policy
description: An organization policy file (--policy, AI_RULEZ_POLICY, or the managed path). A repository can only add restrictions to it. See docs/policy.md.

policy_version.description: The policy format version this ai-rulez reads.

name.description: A label for the policy, shown by validate --show-policy.

allowed_hosts.description: Host patterns every include, installed skill and skill source must fall under (a path prefix is allowed: github.com/example-org). An empty list allows no remote source. Lists of several layers intersect.

deny_hosts.description: Host patterns that are never allowed. Lists of several layers union.

require_pinned.description: true makes the lock enforced, so an unpinned remote source is an error (AR010).

required_codes.description: Rule codes or names that may be neither turned off nor ignored.

severity_floor.description: Rule code or name to the lowest severity it may have.

allowed_hosts.description: Bounds the repository's lint.security.allowed_hosts: only entries this list covers are kept. An empty list allows no host.

scan_imports.description: The weakest scan_imports level the repository may use.

directive_tags.description: Element names AR018 always treats as imitating a privileged message; the repository may add more.

trusted_orgs.description: Bounds the repository's lint.security.trusted_orgs: it may name only these organizations (case-insensitive). An empty list trusts no organization.

max_network_commands.description: The most network commands the repository may allow an item before AR030 reports it; it may set a lower value.

load_budgets.description: Load-budget id (AR964, for example claude-skill-listing) to the largest limit the repository may set; it may set a lower one.

preset.description: The weakest scanner preset the repository may use; a weaker or absent value is raised to it.

required.description: Scanners whose absence or failure is always an error; the repository's own list is added to it.

fail_on.description: The most permissive failure threshold for scanner findings the repository may use.

isolation.description: The weakest isolation the repository may use for staged scanners (none sets no floor).

allow_egress.description: Bounds the repository's allow_egress: only these scanners may be allowed to send content off the machine. An empty list allows none.

enforce.description: true forces [lock] enforce on. false constrains nothing.

include_outputs.description: true forces [lock] include_outputs on. false constrains nothing.

allow_network.description: false switches telemetry export off whatever the user scope says. true constrains nothing.
false switches model calls off whatever the user scope says. true constrains nothing.

generated.description: true forces the generated-file guard hook on. false constrains nothing.

governance.description: Floor under the repository's [governance] table (approvals). The repository may raise it, never lower it.

enforce.description: true makes missing approvals fail lock --check, generate --locked and the skills server. false constrains nothing.

require_approval.description: Selectors (remote, local, all, kind:<kind>) that always need approval; the repository's exempt list cannot narrow them. Layers union.

min_approvers.description: Fewest distinct reviewers per digest. Layers take the largest.

approvers.description: The only reviewers that count (compared lower-cased and trimmed). An empty list means nobody may approve. Layers intersect.

hostPattern.description: host or host/path, case-insensitive. The host may be *.suffix; a path segment may be *, or carry one * at its start or end.
